text:
elaine: quick ping — found an auth/credential mismatch in the Starter App quickstart. CLI example uses REDWOOD_TOKEN but the SDK and console refer to REDWOOD_API_KEY. this will confuse first-time devs and probably break the first deploy flow. can someone own a small PR to unify names and add a Windows env var note? https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/765 :eyes:

sahil: assigning to me. i'll standardize to REDWOOD_API_KEY and add a powershell/setx example. will also search other pages for REDWOOD_TOKEN occurrences.

maya: i can do a quick sweep of the TS + Python snippets while you're at it. also suggest adding a 1-liner "if you see auth errors" troubleshooting bullet under quickstart.

alex: agreed with maya. console calls them "API Key" in the UI, so REDWOOD_API_KEY makes sense.

sahil: plan of attack: update env var name, update example commands, add Windows note, and fix an outdated command reference in the deploy section. i'll push to branch fix/qs-cred-ux and open a PR. example change i'll add:
```
# mac / linux
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=\"sk-...\"

# windows (powershell)
setx REDWOOD_API_KEY \"sk-...\"
```

docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/772 by @sahil — CI: pending

elaine: also noticed the quickstart still says `ri deploy` in the "first deploy" step; the new recommended command is `ri deploy --app your-app`. please update that too so copyedit doesn't reintroduce the old phrasing.

sahil: good catch. i'll update the command and leave a short note in the PR description about CLI version requirements.

maya: once PR is up i'll run the steps locally on mac + windows vm and flag any wording that trips people up. if time i'll add a tiny screenshot for the Windows env var dialog.

alex: :thumbsup:

elaine: target: merge before Friday EOD so the release copyedit can pick it up. tagging product for visibility.

sahil: aiming for tomorrow morning. pinging @docs-bot to run linkcheck after merge.

docs-bot: Link-check started for PR 772 — 3 broken links found (one in examples).

sahil: fixing the broken link now, will push update to same PR.

elaine: perfect, thanks all — small PR but high impact for onboarding new devs.
